recipe.visualDefinition: A central medium-shot portrait of a man in formal attire, layered over a massive, textured monogram that spans the entire background. The composition features heavy, blocky typography that is both horizontally and vertically stretched, interacting with geometric color blocks and a grainy, high-contrast photographic style.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered over a large-scale background letterform
Typography layered both behind and in front of the subject
Contrast between formal business attire and bold, street-style graphic elements
Color palette restricted to royal blue, ochre, and black
coreInvariants: A large, textured 'H' or similar block letter as the primary background anchor
Subject wearing a dark suit with gold accessories
Stretched, wide-set typography at the top and right side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot from the waist up, arms crossed, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive blue textured letterform in the background providing a structural frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves up to the wide header text, then down to the complex typographic cluster on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject, the large background letter, and secondary text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Royal blue with a grainy, stippled texture used for the background monogram.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black used for the suit and primary header text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre/Gold used for secondary text backgrounds and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark suit and the bright, textured blue background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serifs and extended sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy slab serifs with thick, uniform strokes
Vertical stacking of words with varying orientations
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'C' are often nested or scaled down to fit within the negative space of larger letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing ultra-extended slab serifs with vertically oriented sans-serifs on colored blocks.
graphicDevices: Stippled/halftone texture on large background elements
Drop shadows on secondary text blocks

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: City Medium or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif foundation needed for stretching.
Suitable for the condensed vertical text blocks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a 90s-style dark suit and gold watch, arms crossed, against a large royal blue 'H' shape with a grainy, stippled texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-extended black slab-serif text across the top. On the right, add a cluster of text using ochre rectangular backgrounds and vertically oriented words.

verificationChecks: Is the header text horizontally stretched?
Does the background have a visible stippled texture?
Are there ochre color blocks behind the secondary text?
Is the subject wearing a dark suit with a blue shirt?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (ochre can be swapped for red or green)
postGenerationChecks: Check for grainy texture in blue areas
Ensure text is stretched rather than just wide
Verify the 'collage' feel of the text blocks
Confirm the subject's formal attire matches the era
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Large textured monogram background + Stretched slab-serif header + Right-aligned text blocks on colored bars.
